title: a16z Podcast: Not all Network Effects Are Created Equal

reader_summary.source_label: From the episode notes — transcript not yet available
reader_summary.headline: From hardware and hardwires to smartphones and social, technology wants to connect.
reader_summary.overview: From hardware and hardwires to smartphones and social, technology wants to connect. It's almost a native property of technology and especially software businesses, which is why network effects matter. "It was endemic to these technologies that they wanted to become connected and once connected, they become networks and once networks, they become network effects.

key_points.text: Other products like cars or toasters or houses or whatever, aren't natively connected physically or through information sharing," observes James Currier.
But not all network effects are equal -- not only can they be strong or weak, there are many different types depending on the business.
